articles.summary: A detailed examination of Article 163, Article 200, landmark judgments (S.R. Bommai, Shamsher Singh), and recommendations of Sarkaria & Punchhi Commissions for GS Paper 2.
articles.content:
## Context & Background

The role of the Governor in India's federal structure has frequently surfaced as a focal point of constitutional debates...
articles.author: Prof. Ananya Roy
keyTakeaways: Article 163 discretionary powers are subject to judicial review.
Floor test is the mandatory mechanism for determining legislative majority.
Sarkaria and Punchhi commission reports provide actionable governance reforms.

quizzes.title: Daily Prelims Booster: Indian Polity & Constitutional Landmarks
quizzes.description: Test your understanding of Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles, and recent Supreme Court judgments.

questions.questionText: Under Article 21 of the Indian Constitution, the Right to Privacy was declared a fundamental right in which landmark judgment?
options: Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India
Justice K.S. Puttaswamy (Retd.) v. Union of India
A.K. Gopalan v. State of Madras
Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala
questions.explanation: In Justice K.S. Puttaswamy (Retd.) v. Union of India (2017), a nine-judge bench unanimously affirmed that the Right to Privacy is an intrinsic part of the right to life and personal liberty under Article 21.

prompts.title: Sociology Optional Paper 1: Positivism and its Critique in Sociological Inquiry
prompts.questionText: Critically analyze the positivist approach in sociology. How do anti-positivist and interpretative methodologies counter the claim that social reality can be studied through natural science methods? Illustrate with Weberian and Phenomenological traditions. (20 Marks, 250 Words)
prompts.syllabusTag: Paper I - Unit 2: Sociology as Science
prompts.modelAnswer:
## Model Framework

1. **Introduction:** Define Positivism (Auguste Comte, Émile Durkheim)...
2. **Core Positivist Assumptions:** Empiricism, social facts as things...
3. **Anti-Positivist Critiques:** Max Weber (Verstehen), Phenomenology...
4. **Conclusion:** Contemporary sociology embraces methodological triangulation.
